prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Render a complete desktop website screen, edge to edge with no browser frame, for Martino Ferrero, a systems engineer working on backend software, AI and medical imaging research. Its visitors are recruiters and potential clients. Use readable English text: 'Martino Ferrero', 'Software Engineer · AI & Backend', 'Selected work', 'Neurollow', 'Lookeate', and navigation 'Home  About  Projects  Skills  Contact'. Show a centered introductory viewport and the beginning of a real project list below it. This version expresses a measured vertical journey: a fine, understated timeline connects the work as entries reveal sequentially while scrolling. The typography is normal contemporary sans-serif, mostly white, with restrained gray supporting text. The ground is nearly black; any blue or violet is subtle and dark. Keep the layout centered, open and professional; make buttons and links plain and legible. A small portrait may appear lower on the page, never dominating the opening. Use no project illustrations, no bright glows, no giant portrait, no grids of cards, no modal and no oversized decorative neural web. Include at most a few almost invisible lines and points suggesting a neural connection. Focus on rhythm, clear reading and the spacious scroll experience.
